The resulting branch simplifies exactly to \(\alpha_m=2(m-6)/[3(m^2-4)]\). Its discrete difference has numerator \(-m^2+11m+2\), whose positive root lies strictly between \(11\) and \(12\), proving the unique integer maximum at \(m=12\) and \(\alpha_{12}=1/35\). Theorem 3.6 then gives \(\beta=\sqrt{3/\alpha_{12}}=\sqrt{105}\). The register-size parameter is analytical; the source's Algorithm 4 remains a three-copy base test.
